parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system services dhcp pool bas-local.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] range [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool bas-local.command: set system services dhcp pool bas-local range 10.0.0.2 to 10.0.255.254

set system services dhcp network 10.0.0..explanation: 配置DHCP服务的网络地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: accounting
parameters.explanation: 系统计费功能，none表示不进行计费。

set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] range [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range.command: set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range 10.0.0.2 to 10.0.255.254

set system services dhcp multicast-polic.template: set system services dhcp multicast-policy [parameter1] out bandwidth [parameter2] level-1 [parameter3] interface [parameter4]
set system services dhcp multicast-polic.command: set system services dhcp multicast-policy policy1 out bandwidth 10000 level-1 8000 interface ge-0/0/0

parameters.name: level-1
parameters.explanation: 多播策略的级别1带宽限制。

set routing-options multicast sparse-mod.explanation: 配置多播路由为稀疏模式。

set protocols igmp interface ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用IGMP协议。

set system services dhcp bas access-type.template: set system services dhcp bas access-type [parameter1]
set system services dhcp bas access-type.command: set system services dhcp bas access-type layer2-subscriber
set system services dhcp bas access-type.explanation: 配置DHCP BAS访问类型为二层用户。

set system services dhcp bas default-dom.template: set system services dhcp bas default-domain authentication [parameter1]
set system services dhcp bas default-dom.command: set system services dhcp bas default-domain authentication ipv4
set system services dhcp bas default-dom.explanation: 配置DHCP BAS默认域的IPv4认证。

set system services dhcp multicast copy.template: set system services dhcp multicast copy [parameter1]
set system services dhcp multicast copy.command: set system services dhcp multicast copy by-session
set system services dhcp multicast copy.explanation: 配置DHCP多播复制方式为按会话。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.2.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
